closureStatement: Samsung NY63T8751 dual-fuel R1 evidence fits the frozen electric_range rev1 contract without canonical expansion, divergence, or dual-fuel ontology. Gas surface maps to surface_heating_system; electric oven maps to bake/broil/convection instance scopes; gas hardware remains platform overlay vocabulary. electric_range.json is unchanged. R1 is sufficient for CG-13 closure. Cross-manufacturer matrix remains PENDING — not passed. R2 LG LSDL6336F and R3 Whirlpool-family witnesses are DEFERRED/OPTIONAL, not closure prerequisites. Normalization/compounding waits until CG-RANGE-FAMILY-REVIEW organizational gate.

crossManufacturerMatrix.auditNote: Matrix deliberately incomplete at closure — R2/R3 were recommended witnesses, not mandatory. PENDING is preserved for audit trail; do not record as passed.

control_board.rationale: Main PCB participates in both domains but does not create two canonical control functions — display PCB and spark module are implementation unless a distinct functional control role is evidenced.

surface_heating_system.rationale: NY63 spark ignition vs NX60 HSI/valve is implementation variation absorbed by surface_heating_system; spark_module, electrodes, valves, burners remain platform vocabulary.

convection_heating_element.rationale: CG-11 NO_EVIDENCE vs CG-12/CG-13 INHERITS is conditional-scope semantics — compatible, not contradictory.

r1OnlyClosure.rationale: Same governance as CG-12 — R1 answers implementation-fit question; matrix PENDING does not imply universal dual-fuel family proof.

cumulativeFitExperiment.statement: The same frozen electric_range rev1 functional contract survived four materially different heating implementations without canonical mutation.
cumulativeFitExperiment.significance: Demonstrates functional ontology describing appliance behavior rather than fuel-specific hardware.

governanceConclusion.statement: CG-13 demonstrates functional compatibility of the frozen electric-range ontology with a dual-fuel implementation (gas surface + electric oven). It does not establish that gas surface hardware belongs in canonical components[], nor does it authorize renaming the ontology. R1 fit does not substitute for cross-manufacturer matrix completion.
